character.name: Vorik
traits: Stoic resolve that masks relentless rage
Unflinchingly honest, even to his own detriment
Haunted by the guilt of his broken oath
Driven by an unyielding need to avenge his family and clear his name
character.gear: Oathbroken longsword · Dented chain mail · Battered iron shield · Cracked silver holy symbol · 3 dried venison rations · Bitter healing draught · 50ft hempen rope · Flint and tinderbox
character.story: Vorik was a knight of the Silver Order, framed for treason by a jealous lord who coveted his family’s lands. The order stripped his title, burned his manor, and executed his kin. He broke his sacred oath to the order’s god in a futile attempt to save his sister, losing his divine magic. Now he wanders blighted borderlands, stoic and unyielding, hunting the traitors who destroyed his life, burdened by guilt for his broken vow. He will not rest until his name is cleared or his enemies are dead.

inventory.name: Oathbroken Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for Vorik’s knighting ceremony, this notched longsword is etched with the crest of his disgraced house. It has tasted the blood of innocent peasants framed for his supposed treason, a weight he carries as heavily as its steel.
inventory.description: Notched steel longsword with a lion-head pommel, the Vorath crest crudely scratched into the blade’s fuller.

inventory.name: Dented Chain Mail
inventory.lore: Issued to Vorik when he was raised to knighthood, the chain mail is dented from the skirmish where he was framed for treason. The links still hold the faint acrid smell of the burning manor where his family was executed.
inventory.description: Interlocking steel chain mail, dented and scorched in places, inner lining stitched with faded gold thread of his house sigil.

inventory.name: Battered Iron Shield
inventory.lore: The shield bears the cracked crest of the Silver Order Vorik once served, deflected a killing blow during his framing, leaving a deep gouge in its face.
inventory.description: Round iron shield strapped with worn leather, the order’s crest chipped but still visible.

inventory.name: Cracked Silver Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: The holy symbol of the god Vorik once served, cracked down the middle the night he broke his oath. It no longer glows with divine light, but hums faintly when he nears those who betrayed him.
inventory.description: Tarnished silver medallion depicting a winged sword, cracked vertically through the center, strung on a frayed leather cord.
inventory.effects: As an action, activate to reveal the location of any creature that has betrayed Vorik within 60ft for 1 minute. Charges reset at dawn.

inventory.name: Dried Venison Rations
inventory.lore: Taken from the larder of his family’s estate before it was burned, these dried strips of venison are the last remaining food from his former life.
inventory.description: Tough, leathery strips of dried venison, wrapped in oiled cloth.
inventory.effects: Provides enough sustenance for one day per strip.

inventory.name: Bitter Healing Draught
inventory.lore: Brewed by a hedge witch who once served his family, the draught tastes of bile and wild herbs, but closes wounds faster than any surgeon’s salve.
inventory.description: Small glass vial of murky brown liquid, sealed with a wax stopper stamped with a raven’s head.

inventory.name: 50ft Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Rope taken from the stables of his family’s estate, used to tie his horse the night he fled the burning manor.
inventory.description: Coil of rough hempen rope, frayed at the ends, stained with mud and ash.

inventory.name: Flint and Tinderbox
inventory.lore: A plain iron tinderbox, a gift from his father when he was squired, the flint still holds a faint scorch mark from the night he burned his family’s keepsakes to hide his identity.
inventory.description: Small iron tinderbox with a piece of flint and a bundle of dry tinder.
inventory.effects: Can start a fire in 1 minute, even in light rain.
